name: whatsapp
description: Reads a WhatsApp conversation export by its DELTA against the previous export: the messages and attachments that arrived since, extracted beside the zip, with the new voice notes handed to a local transcriber and folded back into one readable digest. Absorbs what the format does to an unsuspecting diff — the clock that drifts between exports, the suffix a repeated filename gains — and refuses a pair of exports that is not the same conversation.
